name: Mozambique to Gangavaram — Deepwater Terminal Unlocks Capesize Economies of Scale
disclaimer: [DEMO] Synthetic scenario parameters for demonstration purposes.

test_vessels.reason: Gangavaram 18.0m deepwater draft accommodates fully laden Capesize up to 200,000 DWT
Panamax is compatible but requires twice as many voyages for the same volume

expected_outcomes.key_insight: Gangavaram's 18.0m deep draft and 35k MT/day mechanized unloading unlocks fully laden Capesize economics. Transporting 160k MT via a single Capesize costs ~$11/MT versus ~$15.50/MT on Panamax or ~$19/MT on Supramax, delivering over $700,000 in direct freight savings per voyage.
